table_title: List football clubs with at least 2 European Cup and UEFA Champions League titles combined (per Wikipedia's `List of European Cup and UEFA Champions League finals` master article's `By club` per-club tally, which treats the European Cup era (1955-1992) and UEFA Champions League era (1992-present) as one continuous trophy lineage; tally reflects completed finals through the 2024-25 season, master accessed 2026-05-18). 13 rows ranked by titles DESC; tiebreakers at 6 / 3 / 2-title ties are First Title Year ASC then Club ASC as curator sort normalizations.
db_analog: SELECT c.club, c.country, c.titles, c.first_title_year, c.most_recent_title_year FROM european_cup_ucl_titles_by_club c WHERE c.titles >= 2 ORDER BY c.titles DESC, c.first_title_year ASC, c.club ASC
temporal_note: Master accessed 2026-05-18; tally reflects completed finals through the 2024-25 season (PSG won the 2025 final and is now a single-title club, so PSG is NOT in the staged ≥ 2 universe). The source separately lists the 2025-26 final as upcoming, so 2025-26 results are not yet part of the title totals. Wikipedia `List of European Cup and UEFA Champions League finals` master article (roles = [universe, ranking, value]: scope-defines the club universe via the article's `By club` per-club tally, supplies the title-count ranking, supplies Club / Country / Titles / First Title Year / Most Recent Title Year cell values from the same per-club table). source_count = 1 registered. Per-club Wikipedia articles (Real Madrid CF, AC Milan, Bayern Munich, etc.) are validation-only context and NOT registered per the artifact contract. Universe = 13 clubs whose total European Cup era (1955-1992) + UEFA Champions League era (1992-present) title count per the master's `By club` table is at least 2 — the master treats both eras as one continuous trophy lineage per its own framing 'Prior to the 1992-93 season, the tournament was named the European Cup'. The pooled-era convention is universal football-journalism shorthand (e.g., Real Madrid's '15 Champions League titles' counts both eras). temporal_sensitivity = medium because the tally updates per season; the 13-row universe is stable as of 2024-25 but if any single-title club (Manchester City, PSG, Hamburger SV, Marseille, etc.) wins a second title in a future season, the universe shifts. Per-row cells: Club + Country derived from the master's per-row content (Country is embedded via flag-icon + linked country text before the Club name in each row — a normalized extraction from a single source, not a separate verbatim Country header; the master does not expose a standalone Country column); Titles + First Title Year + Most Recent Title Year are extracted from the master's `By club` table (Titles is the master's `Title(s)` column verbatim; First/Most Recent Title Year are min/max of the displayed final-year integer list in the master's `Seasons won` column — the master already displays final years as integers (1956, 1957, ..., 2024) rather than season-notation strings). The '≥ 2 titles' threshold rule is deterministic; no curator-judgment selection. Sort = Titles DESC primary; First Title Year ASC secondary tiebreak at the 6-title tie (Bayern Munich 1974 < Liverpool 1977), the 3-title tie (Inter Milan 1964 < Manchester United 1968), and the 5-way 2-title tie (Benfica 1961 < Nottingham Forest 1979 < Juventus 1985 < Porto 1987 < Chelsea 2012); Club ASC final tiebreak (not triggered at this universe). The First-Title-Year ASC tiebreak is a curator sort normalization, documented as such.
_extraction_notes: Aggregation instance — single-table COUNT-GROUP-BY-club aggregation (pre-aggregated COUNT cell from master) with deterministic ≥ 2 threshold filter on the aggregated count. Same operation_type pattern as `films_winning_at_least_8_academy_awards` (Oscar count threshold on pre-aggregated COUNT) and `us_presidents_count_by_birth_state` (state-birth COUNT GROUP BY president-birth-state). Brings `aggregation` from gap 2 (3 of 5: us_presidents_count_by_birth_state + programming_languages_by_decade_of_first_appearance + films_winning_at_least_8_academy_awards) to **gap 1 (4 of 5)** — one more saturates as the 11th fully-cleared category (alongside `comparative` and `hierarchical_decomposition`). Sports/Football NEW SUBDOMAIN under Sports family (Sports family extends from 3 to 4 instances; existing Sports subdomains: Sports/Olympics — `summer_olympics_hosts_1960_2020` + `trial_join_2`; Sports/Tennis — `tennis_players_with_more_than_5_grand_slam_singles_titles`). NEW `organizations/sports-clubs` fine-class extending under-represented organizations bucket from 4 to 5 instances (joining universities, companies, space-agencies, ports — the bucket just-extended in prior cycles by ports). The `sports-clubs` fine-class is intentionally broader than `football-clubs` to leave room for future hockey / baseball / basketball aggregation instances without forcing a re-classification. Schema: 5 cols (Club PK + Country + Titles + First Title Year + Most Recent Title Year); Titles is the pre-aggregated aggregation cell that defines row selection. Sort: Titles DESC primary (largest first); First Title Year ASC secondary tiebreak (curator sort normalization at the 6-title + 3-title + 5-way-2-title ties); Club ASC final tiebreak (not triggered at the current 13-row universe). claim_type = `source_defined` per audit-cycle-1 design review APPROVE-WITH-AMENDMENTS — universe scope (clubs with ≥ 2 titles per master's `By club` pooled-era tally) + ranking rule (Titles DESC) + value cells (Club, Country, Titles, First / Most Recent Year derived per master) all from one master; only curator input is the ≥ 2 threshold which is deterministic. Audit-cycle-1 amendments applied: (1) ID renamed from `uefa_champions_league_titles_per_club` to `clubs_with_at_least_2_european_cup_and_uefa_champions_league_titles` — makes the threshold AND the pooled European Cup + UCL scope visible in the ID; (2) Year extraction premise corrected: the master's `Seasons won` column already displays final-year integers (1956, 1957, ..., 2024), NOT season-notation strings (1955-56) — First/Most Recent Title Year cells are min/max of the displayed final-year integer list, NOT season-notation parsing; (3) Country sourcing documented precisely: master-derived from the embedded country flag-icon + linked country text in each row's Club cell (a normalized single-source extraction, NOT a separate verbatim Country header — the master does not expose a standalone Country column); source_count stays at 1; (4) Cycle-0 row-count corrected from 44 to 42 total rows in the master's `By club` table (24 title-winning clubs + 18 runner-up-only clubs); the staged ≥ 2 universe of 13 rows is unaffected. Per-question recommendations applied: (Q1) Country sourceability single-source from Club cell embed; (Q2) ≥ 2 threshold confirmed (24/13/8/5 at ≥ 1/2/3/5); (Q3) First Title Year ASC tiebreak as curator sort norm; (Q4) pooled European Cup + UCL convention inherited from master; (Q5) defunct/renamed Steaua București + Red Star Belgrade out of scope at ≥ 2; (Q6) integer final-year extraction (no season-string parsing); (Q7) Country forms master-verbatim (England + Scotland for British clubs); (Q8) Club name master-verbatim (Milan not AC Milan; Bayern Munich not FC Bayern München; Inter Milan; Manchester United); (Q9) column name 'Titles' (cleanest normalization of master header `Title(s)`); (Q10) organizations/sports-clubs entity class (broader than football-clubs to enable future cross-sport instances); (Q11) operation_type = aggregation (pre-aggregated COUNT cell); (Q12) deterministic-universe-rule preference satisfied (SQL-WHERE = `titles >= 2`).
